androidPermissions.description: Full functionality requires Root and overlay access. You can instead use basic mode without granting Accessibility access.

basic.description: No Root, Accessibility, or overlay access. Captures while the app is visible and keeps history, sync, copy, and manual paste.
basic.title: Basic mode

full.description: Continuously captures in the background, opens from a bottom-corner swipe, and pastes through Root.
full.title: Full mode

onboarding.changeLater: You can change this later from the Clipboard page or the top of Preferences.
onboarding.chooseMode: Choose full mode or basic mode to continue.

battery.description: Reduces background suspension and cleanup of full-mode services.
battery.title: Ignore battery optimization

notification.description: Allows the persistent full-mode service notification.
notification.title: Notification permission

overlay.description: Only draws the swipe targets and clipboard panel; Root captures the global gesture.
overlay.title: Overlay access

root.description: Requests access from the Root manager only when you tap the button. Status refresh never opens the authorization prompt.
root.title: Root access

androidPermissions.title: Android mode
